text:
ari: heads up, opened a docs PR for the error reference page — covers 429s, timeouts, and context-limit fallbacks. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2987
noah: nice, lemme skim. do we have a short migration note for SDK v2 -> v3 behavior around automatic retries?
ari: not yet, added a TODO in the PR description. goal is minimal changes: show explicit retry + fallback to smaller model example.
maria: for examples i'd keep them tiny. one JS snippet showing exponential backoff, and one curl fallback to embed-only mode.
maria: snippet idea:
```js
// SDK v3-ish fallback pattern
try {
  const r = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-xl', input: prompt })
  return r.output_text
} catch (err) {
  if (err.code === 429) {
    // fallback: shorter context, smaller model, or cached prompt
    const short = prompt.slice(-1024)
    return await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-medium', input: short })
  }
  throw err
}
```
kevin: small nit: use `statusCode` in the snippet instead of `code` to match our SDK error shape? some runtimes surface `status` though. we should mention both.
ari: good call. i'll update. also adding note about server-side rate-limit headers (Retry-After) so customers can do smarter waits.
noah: can we include a one-liner migration table in the guide: old behavior -> new behavior (e.g., implicit queueing -> 429 with Retry-After)? that helped legal and platform teams previously.
ari: done in the PR, added table and a short example showing how to read `Retry-After` from response headers.
maria: link fix: the anchor for "context window" in the model catalog page changed — i updated the crosslink in the PR but please double-check other references.
kevin: also add a short blurb under "fallbacks" recommending prefix caching for repeated prompts (saves tokens and often avoids 429s).
ari: adding that. @docs-bot can you run the link-check for this branch?
docs-bot: link-checker: queued link-scan for PR #2987 — will post results as a comment when done. :robot_face:
noah: QA ask: can we include a test prompt and expected behavior table for the community examples? e.g., long prompt -> 429 -> fallback to cached prefix -> success. keeps it reproducible.
maria: +1. i'll add a tiny eval snippet and expected outputs.
kevin: last thing: update the SDK snippets page to note the new `429` handling APIs (explicit `retryAfterMs`) and include sample constants for backoff.
ari: i'll add constants and a tiny helper util in the snippet: `const backoff = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms))`
ari: ok i've pushed updates to the PR (commit a1b2c3d). request reviews from @noah and @maria.
noah: reviewing now, will leave inline comments for wording.
maria: LGTM pending small wording tweak on the Retry-After paragraph.
ari: thanks — will merge once link-check passes and kevin signs off on the SDK shape.
docs-bot: link-checker: finished — 0 broken links, 2 warnings (anchor mismatch fixed in latest commit).
kevin: approving the content and snippet shape. go ahead and merge after squash. :thumbsup:
ari: merged and scheduled a small follow-up to add the eval harness. thanks y'all!
